lightSettings.reconnectLightFlow.help.ti: I need help connecting a light
lightSettings.reconnectLightFlow.intro.a: Reconnecting will reset the light. This will remove any previous connections.
lightSettings.reconnectLightFlow.intro.s:
Reconnecting a light or smart plug will help in making it reachable or could help to solve the issues you’re experiencing with this light.

Use the QR code on the device. If the device has no QR code, follow the instructions.
lightSettings.reconnectLightFlow.noQrCod:
You can reconnect lights by using their 6-character setup codes/serial numbers. Alternatively you can search for lights. To make sure that you can find a light, you need to first reset it by using a dimmer switch.

<emph>Note:</emph> Adding or reconnecting devices with a QR code enhances the security of your system. If you'd like to continue with a QR code, go back.
lightSettings.reconnectLightFlow.nonHueM:
First you need to <emph>factory reset</emph> 3rd party lights.

Check with its <emph>manufacturer</emph> or in its manual how to factory reset this light. After resetting, tap try again to search for this light.
I need help reconnecting a light
lightSettings.reconnectLightFlow.qrCodeS: This isn't a Hue QR code. Please scan another one.
Scan the QR code of $deviceName$ to reconnect
lightSettings.reconnectLightFlow.searchW:
Make sure lights are reset before you try to reconnect them. You can reset a light using a Dimmer switch by following the steps below.

<olist><litem>Hold the dimmer switch up to the light you want to reconnect to. Stay within 15 cm of the light.</litem><litem>Press and hold the <emph>On and off</emph> or <emph>On/Off and Hue button</emph> until the light flashes, this takes about 20 seconds.</litem></olist>

Tap Try again to search for this light.

Still having trouble? Contact support and they'll help you.
I need help reconnecting a light
lightSettings.reconnectLightFlow.useDimm:
Make sure you reset your lights before you try to reconnect them. You can do so with a dimmer switch by following the steps below.

First, turn the light off for <emph>10 seconds</emph>, disconnecting it from electricity completely. Then, turn it back on. 

Next, hold the dimmer switch <emph>within 15 cm</emph> of the light you want to reconnect. Press and hold the <emph>On and off</emph> or the <emph>On/Off and Hue</emph> buttons for about <emph>20 seconds</emph> until the light flashes. 

Once you’ve reset your lights and you’re ready to reconnect them, tap <emph>Search</emph> to start searching.
lightSettings.reconnectNonHueLightFlow.i: First you need to <emph>factory reset</emph> 3rd party lights. Check with its <emph>manufacturer</emph> or in its manual how to factory reset this light. After resetting, try reconnecting it by tapping Reconnect via the search below.
